guide.overview: A powerful **physical Firepower** Champion, Lobo **charges in on his bike**, **summons clones**, and **empowers his basic attacks** after casting his Ultimate.

legacyPieces.name: Spacehog
legacyPieces.reason: Lobo's signature gear. Increases Crit Rate. Casting the Ultimate increases Physical Penetration for a set duration. Also increases basic attack damage. When taking lethal damage for the first time, HP is set to 1 and immediately restores a portion of max HP. Can be triggered once per battle.

legacyPieces.name: Tectonic Disruptor
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Crit Rate and has a chance to reduce enemy healing. As a physical Firepower Champion, Lobo thrives on high crits and empowered basic attacks. The Tectonic Disruptor ramps up his crit potential and complements his healing reduction effect from basic attacks.

legacyPieces.name: Cold Gun
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Attack and Accuracy, ensuring Lobo's attacks and skills land reliably, ideal for his Ultimate and empowered basic attacks.

legacyPieces.name: Lawton Rifle Scope
legacyPieces.reason: Provides steady Attack and Crit Rate bonuses for consistent, reliable damage output.
